nodes.name: resources.rs
nodes.summary: Implements `McpClient` resource operations — listing resources and templates, and reading a resource's content by URI.

nodes.name: has_resources
nodes.summary: Reports whether the connected server advertised the resources capability.

nodes.name: list_resources
nodes.summary: Fetches the list of resources advertised by the MCP server.

nodes.name: read_resource
nodes.summary: Reads a resource's content from the MCP server by URI.

nodes.name: list_resource_templates
nodes.summary: Fetches the list of URI-templated resources advertised by the MCP server.

nodes.name: state.rs
nodes.summary: Accessor and lifecycle helpers for `McpClient` — status snapshotting, shutdown/cancellation, notification-channel handoff, and a debug-only synthetic notification injector for E2E tests.

nodes.name: tools
nodes.summary: Returns a snapshot clone of the client's currently cached tool definitions.

nodes.name: name
nodes.summary: Returns the configured server name for this client.

nodes.name: config
nodes.summary: Returns a reference to the client's `McpServerConfig`.

nodes.name: instructions
nodes.summary: Returns the server-provided usage instructions from the initialize handshake, if any.

nodes.name: is_alive
nodes.summary: Checks whether the client's connection is currently alive by inspecting the alive flag and service handle.

nodes.name: status
nodes.summary: Builds an `McpServerStatus` snapshot from the client's current connection state, tool count, last error, and connected-at timestamp.

nodes.name: shutdown
nodes.summary: Cancels the underlying rmcp service, cleanly tearing down the transport (killing the child process for stdio) and marking the client dead.

nodes.name: take_notification_rx
nodes.summary: Takes ownership of the client's notification receiver channel, allowing a single consumer to drain server-pushed notifications.

nodes.name: debug_push_notification
nodes.summary: Debug-only helper that injects a synthetic `ServerNotification` into the client's channel so E2E tests can exercise notification handling without a cooperative server.

nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands for MCP server management used by the frontend settings UI: listing/updating/testing servers, connection lifecycle management via `McpState`, and resource/prompt browsing.

nodes.name: resolve_path
nodes.summary: Resolves an MCP config scope (Global/Workspace) plus optional workspace path into the concrete on-disk config file path.

nodes.name: McpState
nodes.summary: Tauri-managed state holding the live `McpManager`, providing connection-lifecycle helpers (ensure_connected, reconnect) shared by every MCP command.

nodes.name: ensure_connected
nodes.summary: Ensures MCP servers are connected for the default (global) workspace scope, lazily connecting on first use.

nodes.name: ensure_connected_with_workspace_scope
nodes.summary: Ensures MCP servers are connected for a specific workspace scope, loading merged config and connecting any not-yet-connected servers.

nodes.name: ensure_connected_background
nodes.summary: Kicks off MCP server connection in a background task without blocking the caller.

nodes.name: reconnect
nodes.summary: Forces a specific MCP server to disconnect and reconnect, used for manual retry and config-change scenarios.

nodes.name: McpTestResult
nodes.summary: Result payload for the `mcp_test_server` command: success flag, tool count, and error detail.

nodes.name: mcp_list_servers
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the status of every configured MCP server.

nodes.name: mcp_update_servers
nodes.summary: Tauri command that writes a full replacement set of MCP server configs and reconciles live connections to match.

nodes.name: mcp_test_server
nodes.summary: Tauri command that attempts a one-off connection to a server config to validate it before saving.

nodes.name: mcp_list_server_tools
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the cached tool list for a specific connected MCP server.

nodes.name: mcp_reconnect_server
nodes.summary: Tauri command that triggers a manual reconnect of a specific MCP server.

nodes.name: mcp_set_server_disabled
nodes.summary: Tauri command that toggles a single MCP server's disabled flag and persists it to config.

nodes.name: mcp_bulk_set_disabled
nodes.summary: Tauri command that toggles the disabled flag for multiple MCP servers in one batch.

nodes.name: mcp_bulk_reconnect
nodes.summary: Tauri command that triggers reconnect for multiple MCP servers in one batch.

nodes.name: mcp_get_config
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the raw merged MCP server configuration for display/editing in the UI.

nodes.name: mcp_list_resources
nodes.summary: Tauri command listing resources advertised by a specific connected MCP server.

nodes.name: mcp_read_resource
nodes.summary: Tauri command reading a specific resource's content from an MCP server by URI.

nodes.name: mcp_list_resource_templates
nodes.summary: Tauri command listing URI-templated resources advertised by a specific MCP server.

nodes.name: McpPromptEntry
nodes.summary: Serializable entry pairing a server name with one of its advertised prompts, used by the all-servers prompt listing command.

nodes.name: mcp_list_prompts
nodes.summary: Tauri command listing prompts advertised by a specific connected MCP server.

nodes.name: mcp_list_all_prompts
nodes.summary: Tauri command aggregating prompts across every connected MCP server into one list.

nodes.name: mcp_get_prompt
nodes.summary: Tauri command fetching a specific prompt's raw messages from an MCP server.

nodes.name: mcp_render_prompt
nodes.summary: Tauri command fetching and flattening a specific prompt's rendered text from an MCP server.

nodes.name: config.rs
nodes.summary: Loads, merges, and persists MCP server configuration from global (~/.orgii/mcp-servers.json) and workspace-scoped (.orgii/mcp-servers.json) files, with workspace entries overriding global by server name while ORing the disabled flag.

nodes.name: McpTransportType
nodes.summary: Enum of supported MCP transport kinds: Stdio, Sse, StreamableHttp.

nodes.name: McpServerConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for a single MCP server: transport type, command/args/cwd/env for stdio, url/headers for HTTP transports, auto-approved tools, disabled flag, and timeout.

nodes.name: McpConfigScope
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing global (per-user) from workspace-scoped MCP config file locations.

nodes.name: McpConfigFile
nodes.summary: Root config file structure mapping server name to `McpServerConfig`, with load/save/merge helpers that preserve disabled servers so they remain toggleable in the UI.

nodes.name: global_config_path
nodes.summary: Returns the on-disk path of the global MCP server config file (~/.orgii/mcp-servers.json).

nodes.name: workspace_config_path
nodes.summary: Returns the on-disk path of a workspace's MCP server config file.

nodes.name: insert_server_config
nodes.summary: Loads a config file, inserts/replaces one server's entry, and saves it back, failing safe rather than overwriting an unparseable existing file.

nodes.name: locate_owning_config
nodes.summary: Determines which config file (workspace or global) currently owns a given server name, checking workspace first per the merge precedence.

nodes.name: env_expansion.rs
nodes.summary: Expands `${VAR}` and `${VAR:-default}` POSIX-style environment variable placeholders throughout an MCP server config's command/args/env/url/headers fields, erroring on unset required variables instead of silently substituting an empty string.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-rolled byte-scanning parser rather than a regex, matching POSIX parameter-expansion default-value syntax without supporting nested substitution.

nodes.name: MissingEnvVar
nodes.summary: Error type for a bare `${VAR}` placeholder referencing an unset environment variable with no default.

nodes.name: expand
nodes.summary: Expands `${VAR}` and `${VAR:-default}` placeholders in a single string, erroring for unset variables with no default.

nodes.name: expand_server_config
nodes.summary: Expands env-var placeholders across every relevant field of an `McpServerConfig` in place (command, args, env values, url, headers), leaving `cwd` untouched.

nodes.name: errors.rs
nodes.summary: Typed error taxonomy for MCP tool calls — Auth, SessionExpired, ToolError, Timeout, Transport, Other — classified from rmcp's `ServiceError` by inspecting HTTP status and JSON-RPC error codes, used to drive reconnect and auth-flow decisions.

nodes.name: McpCallError
nodes.summary: Enum classifying an MCP tool-call failure into Auth/SessionExpired/ToolError/Timeout/Transport/Other, each carrying the server name for attribution, with a `classify_service_error` constructor and `is_terminal` reconnect-trigger predicate.

nodes.name: handler.rs
nodes.summary: Implements rmcp's `ClientHandler` trait for ORGII's MCP client, converting server-push notifications into an internal `HandlerEvent` enum and explicitly denying server-initiated sampling/elicitation requests since neither capability is advertised.

nodes.name: HandlerEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of server-push notification kinds forwarded from the rmcp handler to the rest of the codebase: tool/prompt/resource list-changed and resource-updated.

nodes.name: AgentClientHandler
nodes.summary: rmcp `ClientHandler` implementation that fans out server notifications to a channel, denies sampling/elicitation requests with a loud warning, and dispatches progress notifications to per-token subscribers.

nodes.name: deny_sampling_response
nodes.summary: Builds the method-not-found error response returned for every server-initiated `sampling/createMessage` request, matching rmcp's default rejection.

nodes.name: deny_elicitation_response
nodes.summary: Builds the spec-compliant Decline response returned for every server-initiated `elicitation/create` request.

nodes.name: create_message
nodes.summary: `ClientHandler::create_message` implementation that logs a warning and denies every server-initiated sampling request.

nodes.name: create_elicitation
nodes.summary: `ClientHandler::create_elicitation` implementation that logs a warning and declines every server-initiated elicitation request.

nodes.name: on_resource_updated
nodes.summary: `ClientHandler::on_resource_updated` implementation that forwards a resource-updated notification's URI to the event channel.
